requirement: The system shall accept a user prompt as text input before it reaches the enterprise LLM application.
measurable_goal: Prompt input should be accepted as a string and passed to the detection pipeline.

requirement: The system shall classify each prompt as Benign or Malicious.
measurable_goal: Each input prompt must return one binary class label.

requirement: The system shall generate an operational decision: Allow, Review, or Block.
measurable_goal: Each prediction must be mapped to a security decision using malicious probability thresholds.

requirement: The system should minimize missed malicious prompts.
measurable_goal: Malicious recall should be prioritized as the primary evaluation metric.

requirement: The system should provide reproducible model artifacts.
measurable_goal: Final model, vectorizer, metrics, and metadata must be saved as versioned artifacts.

requirement: The system should support explainable and auditable evaluation.
measurable_goal: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, confusion matrix, and classification report must be generated.
